topics.title: Asian Phase 1 Trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH Cirrhosis Patients – PEC Content Endorsement (Julia Zhu)

background.text: Presented by Julia Zhu at PEC on 15 Dec 2025 for content endorsement. Two scenarios discussed, including Scenario 2 where PMDA requests Asian data but CDE does not.
background.quote: (E) Asian phase 1 trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH cirrhosis patients Julia Zhu

for_endorsement.text: Asian Phase 1 trial on FAP/TRAILR2 in MASH cirrhosis patients submitted for PEC content endorsement.

decision.text: PEC did not endorse. PEC suggested team evaluate the value of enrolling limited Chinese patients against increased resource and operational complexity under Scenario 2 (CDE not request, but PMDA requests Asian data). PEC also suggested clearly clarifying the two consultation questions and whether intensive PK could be waived through this Asian Phase 1. An ad hoc PEC meeting will be planned for further endorsement.
decision.quote:
Not Endorsed
PEC comments:
• PEC suggested team to evaluate the value by enrollment of limited Chinese patients, and the invested resource
and operational complexity increased under scenario 2 (CDE not request, but PMDA request Asian data)
• PEC suggested team to clearly clarify the two questions for consultation, and if an intensive PK could be waived
through this Asian phase 1.
• An ad hoc PEC meeting will be planned for further endorsement.

todo.text: Julia Zhu to address PEC comments and prepare for ad hoc PEC meeting for further endorsement. Due: Next PEC. Status: not completed.
